report_fields.indicator_label: HC01: New clients enrolled in HIV care
report_fields.sqlQuery:
WITH base_pop AS (
  WITH A AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.patient_id AS patient_id FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary a
  JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_patient_demographics mdp
    ON mdp.patient_id = a.patient_id
  WHERE
    a.hiv_enrollment_date >= :startDate
    AND a.hiv_enrollment_date < :endDate
    AND mdp.birthdate IS NOT NULL
    AND mdp.gender IS NOT NULL
  ),
  B AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.patient_id AS patient_id FROM mamba_fact_transfer_in a
  JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_patient_demographics mdp
    ON mdp.patient_id = a.patient_id
  WHERE
    a.encounter_date >= :startDate
    AND a.encounter_date < :endDate
    AND mdp.birthdate IS NOT NULL
    AND mdp.gender IS NOT NULL
    AND a.transfer_in_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
  )
  SELECT DISTINCT
      A.patient_id
  FROM A
  LEFT JOIN B
      ON B.patient_id = A.patient_id
  WHERE B.patient_id IS NULL
),
ag AS (
  SELECT
    ag.age_group_id,
    ag.label,
    ag.min_age_days,
    ag.max_age_days,
    ag.sort_order
  FROM report_builder_dim_age_group ag
  JOIN report_builder_dim_age_category ac
    ON ac.age_category_id = ag.age_category_id
  WHERE ac.code = 'HMIS_106A'
  AND ag.is_active = 1
),
genders AS (
  SELECT 'F' AS gender
  UNION ALL SELECT 'M' AS gender
),
cnt AS (
  SELECT
    ag.age_group_id AS age_group_id,
    mdp.gender AS gender,
    COUNT(DISTINCT base_pop.patient_id) AS value
  FROM base_pop
  JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_patient_demographics mdp
    ON mdp.patient_id = base_pop.patient_id
  JOIN ag
    ON TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, mdp.birthdate, :endDate)
       BETWEEN ag.min_age_days AND ag.max_age_days
  WHERE mdp.birthdate IS NOT NULL
  AND mdp.gender IS NOT NULL
  AND mdp.gender IN ('F','M')
  GROUP BY ag.age_group_id, mdp.gender
)
SELECT
  ag.label AS age_group,
  g.gender AS gender,
  COALESCE(cnt.value, 0) AS value
FROM ag
CROSS JOIN genders g
LEFT JOIN cnt
    ON cnt.age_group_id = ag.age_group_id
   AND cnt.gender = g.gender
ORDER BY ag.sort_order, g.gender;

report_fields.indicator_label: HC03 Active on Pre-ART at quarter end
report_fields.sqlQuery:
WITH base_pop AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.client_id AS patient_id
  FROM mamba_flat_encounter_art_card_1 a
  JOIN mamba_flat_encounter_art_summary_card s
      ON s.client_id = a.client_id
  WHERE s.hiv_enrollment_date <= :endDate
    AND DATE(a.encounter_datetime) BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
    AND (
        s.transfer_out_date IS NULL
        OR s.transfer_out_date > :endDate
    )
    AND (
        s.date_lost_to_followup IS NULL
        OR s.date_lost_to_followup > :endDate

report_fields.indicator_label: HC07: Active ART clients transferred in
report_fields.sqlQuery:
WITH base_pop AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.patient_id
  FROM (
           SELECT ti.client_id as patient_id
           FROM mamba_fact_transfer_in ti
           WHERE ti.transfer_in_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate

           UNION

           SELECT s.client_id as patient_id
           FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s
           WHERE s.transfer_in_regimen_start_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
             AND s.transfer_in_regimen IS NOT NULL
             AND TRIM(s.transfer_in_regimen) <> ''
       ) t
  WHERE EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
               JOIN mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card f
                    ON f.encounter_id = a.encounter_id
      WHERE f.patient_id = t.patient_id
        AND ((DATE(a.encounter_date) BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate) || DATE(a.return_visit_date>:endDate))
  )

ag AS (

      AND EXISTS (

WITH base_pop AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT r.patient_id AS patient_id FROM mamba_fact_test_orders_results r
  WHERE r.patient_id IS NOT NULL

    AND UPPER(TRIM(r.test_parameter)) = 'ASPERGILLOSIS RESULTS'

    AND UPPER(TRIM(r.test_value))
          IN ('POSITIVE', 'POS', '(+)', '+')

    AND r.encounter_datetime >= :startDate
    AND r.encounter_datetime < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

    /* Latest CD4 by Aspergillosis result is <200 */
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM mamba_fact_test_orders_results c
        WHERE c.patient_id = r.patient_id
          AND UPPER(TRIM(c.test_parameter)) = 'CD4 COUNT'
          AND c.encounter_datetime <= r.encounter_datetime
          AND TRIM(c.test_value) REGEXP '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'
          AND CAST(c.test_value AS DECIMAL(10,2)) < 200

          AND NOT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM mamba_fact_test_orders_results c2
              WHERE c2.patient_id = c.patient_id
                AND UPPER(TRIM(c2.test_parameter)) = 'CD4 COUNT'
                AND c2.encounter_datetime <= r.encounter_datetime
                AND TRIM(c2.test_value) REGEXP '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'
                AND (
                    c2.encounter_datetime > c.encounter_datetime
                    OR (
                        c2.encounter_datetime = c.encounter_datetime
                        AND c2.id > c.id
                    )
                )
          )
    )

    /* Latest valid VL by Aspergillosis result is non-suppressed */
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM mamba_fact_viral_load_episode v
        WHERE v.patient_id = r.patient_id
          AND v.result_status = 'VALID'
          AND v.is_unsuppressed = 1
          AND v.is_suppressed = 0
          AND COALESCE(
                v.sample_collection_date,
                v.viral_load_clinical_date,
                v.laboratory_result_date,
                v.order_date
              ) <= r.encounter_datetime

          AND NOT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM mamba_fact_viral_load_episode v2
              WHERE v2.patient_id = v.patient_id
                AND v2.result_status = 'VALID'
                AND COALESCE(
                      v2.sample_collection_date,
                      v2.viral_load_clinical_date,
                      v2.laboratory_result_date,
                      v2.order_date
                    ) <= r.encounter_datetime
                AND (
                    COALESCE(
                        v2.sample_collection_date,
                        v2.viral_load_clinical_date,
                        v2.laboratory_result_date,
                        v2.order_date
                    ) >
                    COALESCE(
                        v.sample_collection_date,
                        v.viral_load_clinical_date,
                        v.laboratory_result_date,
                        v.order_date
                    )
                    OR (
                        COALESCE(
                            v2.sample_collection_date,
                            v2.viral_load_clinical_date,
                            v2.laboratory_result_date,
                            v2.order_date
                        ) =
                        COALESCE(
                            v.sample_collection_date,
                            v.viral_load_clinical_date,
                            v.laboratory_result_date,
                            v.order_date
                        )
                        AND v2.episode_id > v.episode_id
                    )
                )
          )
    )

    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
        WHERE a.patient_id = r.patient_id
          AND (
              (
                  a.encounter_date >= :startDate

              OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate

)

FROM ag
CROSS JOIN genders g
LEFT JOIN cnt
    ON cnt.age_group_id = ag.age_group_id
   AND cnt.gender = g.gender
ORDER BY ag.sort_order, g.gender;
